Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: A voltage will be induced in a wire loop when the magnetic field within that loop

Options: 
A. is amplified
B. converts to magnetic energy
C. is parallel to the electric field
D. changes
E. is at right angles to the electric field
F. converts to electric energy
G. aligns with the electric field
H. is at a 45-degree angle to the electric field
I. is static

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
